title: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www
description:
< Story >"I got reincarnated, and the Demon King's Castle is right next door?! LOL"

Your fading soul is rescued by a goddess, and you're summoned to another world, Luna.

As a "Bounder" gifted with the power of creation, you arrive at a single dilapidated house.

Fix up the house, gather allies, tend the fields, and grow your village. Then, one night, the monsters suddenly start going wild...

"This world belongs to us! ♡ Listen up, my lovely monsters! Go wild, break whatever you want, and have some fun! ♡"

That voice belongs to the Demon King, a pop idol adored by monsters everywhere. Her announcement marks the beginning of the "Demon King Live," sending a massive wave of hyped-up, frenzied monsters stampeding straight toward your village.

< Build Up Your Village Base >Gather materials and craft furniture, structures, and more, with over 30 buildings to construct in all! The more you build, the more villagers arrive, and the stronger you and your village become.

< Pick Your Hat, Change Your Job Class >In this world, hats carry the goddess's power. The hat you wear determines your Job Class.

Ranging from gathering/crafting professions like Farmers and Lumberjacks to combat roles like Warriors and Mages! Choose from more than 20 Job Classes. Experiment freely, swap your hats to match any situation, and find a playstyle that's uniquely yours.

　

< Team Up with Your Villagers and Assign Them Jobs >Assigning a hat to a villager unlocks their true potential. Whether it's a Farmer tilling and harvesting the fields, a Chef keeping everyone fed, or a Guard defending the village from invading monsters, set them to work and watch your Village thrive completely on its own. Bring them along on your adventures, where they will fight by your side, each with their own unique traits and strengths to offer!

< Build Your Fighting Style with the Goddess's Blessings >Offer prayers to the Goddess Statues scattered across the land to receive powerful blessings that aid your journey.

These divine Blessings offer a wide variety of buffs, from boosting attack power and accelerating health recovery to granting uniquely powerful elemental attributes. By stacking multiple Blessings together, you can forge a combat style entirely your own!

< Fend Off the Demon King Live Concert! >"This world belongs to us! ♡"

Your next-door neighbor? Yeah... it's the Demon King's castle.

Every time the Idol Demon King holds a concert, hordes of frenzied monsters descend on your village.

Team up with your villagers, fortify your defenses, and hold back the waves of monsters threatening your home.

Defeat the powerful bosses standing in your way, and the hidden truth of this world will slowly come to light.
description_short: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!
